name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-extensions-react-adal-bot
title: SPFx ADAL Bot Extension
shortDescription: Integrate an authenticated bot into SharePoint using ADAL and the Bot Framework Web Chat control.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework application customizer that hosts a React bot chat control and demonstrates authentication to Azure AD-protected APIs using the OAuth2 authorization code flow. The sample includes a separate Node.js bot project.

thumbnails.alt: Authenticated bot chat within a SharePoint page

references.name: Overview of SharePoint Framework Extensions
references.description: Documentation for extending the SharePoint user experience with SharePoint Framework extensions.
